reusableAutomationAssets.sourceLearning: FIXEDASSETS-287 showed that direct Page-ID URLs may render shell text in the main document while business content lives in a runinframe frame.
Ungescoped New/Neu and menu actions are risky; click helpers need page/context anchors and post-click assertions.
Useful for page/table/field debugging, but not enough for final book screenshots unless target values are visible.
State truth should be updated from compact normalized results instead of raw logs or invented conclusions.
A screenshot is only useful when it shows the target code, value, blocker or intended control point.
Posting, Preview, setup changes and keeping drafts are allowed only when a case unlocks them with evidence and trace requirements.
